description: Propose adding an address to an inbox's send allowlist. This NEVER grants access directly — it files a request for human approval and returns its id. Requires the `propose_policy` capability.

address.description: Email address to propose adding to the inbox's allowlist.

inbox_id.description: Inbox (mailbox) id the proposed sender would be allowed to reach.

name: mailbuttons_propose_sender
title: Propose an allowlisted sender
